overview.text: Explore Silver Peak Portfolio, beginning with whole-house builds and major renovations through focused remodeling projects.

projects.label: Project Categories
projects.heading: Browse from major projects to focused renovations.
projects.text: Browse completed Seattle work by project type and neighborhood. Each project highlights the practical ideas, custom details, and architectural character that shaped the finished result.

part1.subheading: Modern Craftsman Whole House Build in Greenwood
part1.text: A 100-year-old Greenwood Craftsman rebuilt as a modern Craftsman with solar, an EV charger, an open main level, a custom kitchen, basement ADU, primary suite, custom shed, and landscaped outdoor living areas.

part2.text: A full-home renovation with a connected kitchen and living area, updated bathrooms, and a covered outdoor gathering space.

part3.subheading: DADU Project in View Ridge with Butterfly Roof
part3.text: A View Ridge backyard DADU with a deck and shed, an efficient kitchen, natural light, open shelving, under-stair storage, and custom vertical and horizontal Murphy beds.

part4.subheading: Kitchen and Bathroom Remodel in Licton Springs
part4.text: A Licton Springs kitchen and bathroom remodel with blue cabinetry, warm wood accents, open shelving, a custom oak table and built-in bench, an expanded bath, and hallway-integrated storage.

part5.subheading: Bathroom Remodel, Siding Rot Repair, and Exterior Painting in Bitter Lake
part5.text: A bright Bitter Lake full-bath remodel with turquoise tile and black fixtures, paired with siding rot repair and exterior painting.

part6.subheading: Tudor Exterior Restoration and Bathroom/Laundry Renovation in Licton Springs
part6.text: A Licton Springs Tudor restoration with cleaned and re-tuckpointed brick, rebuilt stucco and curved trim, repaired gables, a renewed laundry entry, and bathroom/laundry improvements.

part7.subheading: Accessible Shower Bathroom Remodel in Seattle
part7.text: A refreshed Seattle bathroom with a tiled shower, double wood vanity, natural light, and practical details for daily use.

part8.subheading: Accessible ADA compliant Bathroom and Laundry Renovation in Greenwood
part8.text: An accessible ADA compliant Greenwood bathroom and laundry renovation with a curbless shower, a custom wheelchair-accessible vanity, two pocket doors, built-in shelving, warm wood storage, and integrated laundry function.

part9.subheading: Whole House Interior Remodel in Haller Lake
part9.text: A whole-house interior remodel with custom woodwork, accessible bathrooms, and a renewed front entry.
